proposal.blind_spot: The optimizer sees that DRAM is saturated but cannot tell whether the kernel's requested data volume is redundant (eliminable materialized operands, the winning pattern) or already at the logical minimum (nothing to remove, where rewrites only cause the observed regressions).

rationale.l1tex__t_sectors_pipe_lsu_mem_global_op_: HIGH (requested load bytes >> logical input size) -> eliminate the redundant operand materialization, e.g. replace the expanded bias read with in-kernel broadcast indexing / LOW (requested ~= logical minimum) -> loads are compulsory, stop hunting for read-traffic reductions and keep the simple streaming access pattern

HIGH (requested store bytes >> logical output size) -> remove the extra intermediate write pass / materialized buffer copy / LOW (requested ~= output size) -> writes are minimal and DRAM is saturated, so the kernel is at the roofline: keep the original and avoid regressions like the 0.33x triu and 0.36x exp rewrites
